faq.title: Useful before you publish.
faq.q1: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a1: No. The free tools run in your browser without an account.
faq.q2: Can I use a QR code in print?
faq.a2: Yes. Generate it, download the SVG, and add it to a menu, flyer, sign, or packaging.
faq.q3: How does the restaurant menu sharing work?
faq.a3: Menu data is saved locally and can be encoded in a share link. Large menus and uploaded images are not suited to static share links.
